description: Keeps every pin moving through reviewable PRs: Go modules (service and tools/go.mod), base image digests, the pipeline's and the Makefile's tool versions, the kind smoke test's images. A release must be two weeks old before it is proposed.

kubernetes.description: Plain manifests are not auto-detected: the kind smoke test's throwaway dependencies (postgres/redis/rabbitmq/wiremock images)

customManagers.description: Versions in azure-pipelines.yml marked with a '# renovate:' comment on the line above (optionally 'versioning=...'): tool pins, the DDL gate's PostgreSQL tag, and the Go toolchain (goVersion), which the 'Go toolchain' rule below bumps together with the Dockerfile's golang tag
The Makefile's golangci-lint pin (GOLANGCI_LINT_VERSION := vX.Y.Z), the same depName as the pipeline's so both move in one PR
Image tags in shell scripts (CURL_VERSION=8.10.1 in deploy/kind/kind-smoke.sh) marked with a '# renovate:' comment

packageRules.description: Helm 4 deprecates the deploy step's --atomic (--rollback-on-failure): stay on Helm 3 until the pipeline moves
The Go toolchain is pinned twice — the Dockerfile's golang:<minor>-alpine tag and azure-pipelines.yml goVersion — so one PR bumps both (digest-only updates of the image stay separate)
